label: Tone
description: Vocal timbre and range; flat, harsh or appealing voices.

label: Delivery
description: Expression, phrasing and breath; natural or robotic delivery.

label: Timing
description: Vocal pacing and alignment with the instruments.

label: Clarity
description: Intelligibility and separation of lead and backing vocals.

label: Singer Identity
description: Stable and appropriate singer identity; unwanted voice changes.

label: Timbre
description: Instrument sounds and textures; clear, rich, harsh or screeching.

label: Performance
description: Instrumental execution, articulation and rhythmic control.

label: Interest
description: Engaging or dull instrumental parts.

label: Cleanliness
description: Positive: clean audio. Negative: unwanted fuzz, distortion or glitches.

label: Fidelity
description: Fullness and detail; thin, muffled or phone-speaker sound.

label: Dynamics
description: Controlled loudness and transients; pumping or fluctuating volume.

label: Balance
description: Appropriate levels and separation between voices and instruments.

label: Genre Fit
description: How the recording follows the intended genre.

label: Coherence
description: How well its influences fit together, including genre blends.

label: Structure
description: Effective verses, choruses, bridges and overall development.

label: Variety
description: Positive: effective variety. Negative: excessive repetition.

label: Transitions
description: Section changes, opening and ending; smooth or abrupt.

label: Length
description: Appropriate pacing and duration; dragging or truncated songs.

label: Energy
description: Groove, momentum and vitality; lively or lifeless.

label: Emotional Impact
description: Emotional connection and passion.
